summary: First real test run (previous agent produced nothing). Backend: 39/39 pytest cases pass covering catalog, JWT auth, Emergent Google-session auth (cookie + Bearer + logout deletes row), cart pricing/coupons, orders/COD, wishlist, and full admin CRUD/authorization. Frontend Playwright: home/search/category/PDP/pincode/cart/coupon/wishlist/checkout(COD)/order-detail/admin-panel(all 7 tabs)/authorization/auth-callback-fallback/mobile-overflow all verified working end-to-end. Order IFQ2608132185 was successfully created via COD with correct totals (Subtotal 1599 + COD 49 = 1648, GST 244 inclusive). Google login button present and wired; /account#session_id=fake correctly falls back to /login. Seeded emg_ session_token authenticates via both cookie and Bearer and works on /api/orders and /api/wishlist; POST /api/auth/logout deletes the user_sessions row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 621 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/catalog.py, routers/orders.py, routers/admin.py before adding more features.

CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL, http://localhost:3000] with allow_credentials=True, which is correct for cookie auth, but backend/.env still has CORS_ORIGINS="*" that is unused/misleading — remove it to avoid future confusion.

POST /api/auth/session mixes header X-Session-ID and JSON body — the body is read even when the header is present, which will 400 if body is not JSON. Prefer: only read JSON when header is absent, and guard against JSONDecodeError.

get_current_user treats any Bearer token starting with 'emg_' as a session token but only checks the cookie by exact key match. A malformed 'emg_' bearer will silently fall through to JWT decode with 'Invalid token'; consider returning 401 immediately if 'emg_' prefix matches but session lookup fails.
compute_totals silently skips missing products (continue) — could produce an order with 0 items when a bad id is sent; already handled by the empty-items check, but log a warning for observability.
@app.on_event('startup')/('shutdown') are deprecated in FastAPI 0.109+; switch to lifespan context manager.
test_credentials: admin@infykraq.com / Admin@123, customer@infykraq.com / Test@123, coupons WELCOME10/FLAT200/INFY15
seed_data_creation: Test created one COD order IFQ2608132185 for customer@infykraq.com; a few TEST_ newsletter subscribers and TEST_ registered users; ephemeral user_sessions rows for the Google-session tests (logout row is auto-deleted). Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and covers all critical endpoints incl. Emergent Google session auth (seeds a user_sessions row via mongosh). Re-run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend flows all verified via Playwright: JWT login, PDP add-to-cart, cart+WELCOME10 coupon, checkout COD -> order detail with order-no/timeline, admin panel (7 tabs), customer /admin -> admin-denied, /account#session_id=fake -> /login fallback, mobile 390px no horizontal overflow. Google button redirects to auth.emergentagent.com — do NOT attempt a real Google login.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. One transient UI observation: after place-order-btn, the toast shows immediately and navigation to /order/<id> races with the toast; my test read the URL too early once and saw /cart, but a follow-up navigation to the order via /account confirmed the order page renders correctly (order-no IFQ2608132185, correct totals, timeline). Not a bug.
